detail.noteRunning: E rere ana te hōtaka i te muri. Ka taea te whakaparahatia te matapihi ki te pae pūnaha.
detail.noExe.title: Kāore anō a Discord kia mōhio ki te exe o tēnei kēmu
detail.noExe.text: Kāore e taea te kite mā te hōtaka. Pēhia te “Whakahou pātengi raraunga” ā muri ake: ina tāpiri a Discord i tētahi exe, ka wātea te kēmu.

running.empty.title: Kāore he mea e rere ana
running.empty.text: Huakina he kēmu i te pātengi kēmu ka pēhi i te “Tīmata decoy”.
settings.title: Tautuhinga
settings.language.desc: Reo atanga. Kua tāpirihia ngā reo hōu hei kōnae ki te kōpaki locales.
settings.defaultTime.desc: E hia ngā meneti hei pupuri i te hōtaka (ko ngā whainga Discord he 15 meneti te nuinga).
settings.autoStop.desc: Ka mutu aunoa te decoy ina mutu te wā.
settings.notify.desc: He whakamōhiotanga Windows ina pau te wā.
settings.tray: Whakaparahatia ki te pae pūnaha ina katia
settings.tray.desc: Ka rere tonu ngā decoy i te wā kei roto te taupānga i te pae pūnaha.

settings.dataDir.desc: Te wāhi pupuri i te rārangi kēmu me ngā tautuhinga.
settings.dataDir.portable: Aratau kawe: ka penapena ngā mea katoa ki te taha o decoy.exe.
settings.legal: Kāore a Decoy e whakamahi i tō tohu Discord, ā, kāore hoki e whakaae ki ngā whainga māu. Tērā pea ka takahi te whaiwhakaaro i tētahi hōtaka kēmu i ngā ture a Discord, nō reira kei a koe tonu te tūponotanga.

toast.timeUp: Kua pau te wā, me tatau te whainga

lab.title: Tātai Rangahau
lab.subtitle: He ripa muna: ka whakarewa i ngā decoy maha i te wā kotahi.
lab.count: E hia ngā kēmu hei whakarewa
lab.count.desc: Ka kōwhiria matapōkeretia ngā kēmu, ka hipa i ērā e rere kē ana. Ka rere ia kēmu mō te {n} men (kua whakaritea ki Tautuhinga).
lab.warn: He hōtaka motuhake me te matapihi tō ia decoy. Ka pōturi pea tō rorohiko ki te neke atu i te 200–300 i te wā kotahi, ko te mōrahi ko te {max}.
